test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma is associated with which of the following dances?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kuchipudi** is a **classical dance form** originating from the state of **Andhra Pradesh, India**.
 
• It derives its name from the village **Kuchipudi** in the Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma is a renowned **Kuchipudi exponent** and has made significant contributions to this art form.
 
• This dance combines **grace, fluid movements, and narrative storytelling**, often depicting themes from Indian mythology.
 
• Kuchipudi performances include both **solo and group acts**, with emphasis on expressions (abhinaya) and intricate footwork.
 
• It is performed with a mix of **dancing, acting, and music**, making it unique among Indian classical dances.
 
• The traditional attire for Kuchipudi dancers includes rich costumes and **ornate jewelry**, which highlight the elegance of the dance.
 
• Some famous Kuchipudi compositions are based on **epics like Ramayana and Mahabharata**, as well as devotional themes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odissi**__

 __
 
• **Odissi** is a classical dance form from **Odisha, India**.
 
• It is characterized by its **soft, lyrical movements** and strong devotional themes, often dedicated to Lord **Jagannath**.
 
• Odissi is predominantly performed by women, with intricate hand gestures and poses.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali**__
 __
 
• **Kathakali** originates from **Kerala, India** and is known for its elaborate costumes, makeup, and masks.
 
• This dance-drama focuses on **mythological stories** and involves intense facial expressions and gestures.
 
• Kathakali performers undergo rigorous training to master the art of communicating emotions through facial expressions and body movements.
 
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam**__
 
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is another classical dance form from **Kerala, India**.
 
• This dance is characterized by its **graceful, feminine movements** and is often referred to as the dance of the **"Enchantress."**
 
• Mohiniyattam performances typically convey themes of **love and devotion**.
